b0b.dev - the intro film

A three-minute film in eight parts, cut from public-domain and CC0 archive footage, narrated, with every shot's source printed on screen while it plays. The picture is cut and scaled and nothing else.

Sources

  • Universal Newsreel, Nazis Face War Crime Evidence, 6 Dec 1945 - NARA via the Internet Archive, public domain
  • Universal Newsreel, Hollywood 'Red' Probe Begins, 20 Oct 1947 - NARA via the Internet Archive, public domain
  • US Department of Energy, Operation Ivy (1952), film 0800012 - Internet Archive, CC0
  • Universal Newsreel, First U.S. Satellite Launched!, 3 Feb 1958 - NARA via the Internet Archive, public domain
  • Universal Newsreel, The Cuban Crisis, 25 Oct 1962 - NARA via the Internet Archive, public domain
  • Universal Newsreel, Peace March, 18 Apr 1967 - NARA via the Internet Archive, public domain
  • Iran-Contra Hearings, 8 Jul 1987 - NARA ARC 11161 via the Internet Archive, CC0
